text: What if you dropped a ball straight through the Earth?
Guess how long until it comes out the other side.
There's no air in here, so it never stops speeding up.
Faster than a bullet. Faster than a fighter jet.
At the dead center, it's flying faster than the space station.
Then gravity flips, and starts dragging it back.
Thirty-eight minutes later, the other side of the world.
It stops. Right at the top.
Just one problem. The core is as hot as the Sun, so the hole would melt shut.
But if it didn't, this ball would pop back up right here, every seventy-six minutes. Forever. Subscribe for more what-ifs.
